constraints: Import transitions cannot change source, satisfy current source-change coverage, overwrite manually authored intent or create active or verified bindings
Exclude canonical metadata and retained source objects from model source evidence
description: Reconstruct Git history as portable, versioned intent records, historical bindings and import events, available through normal agent queries.
rationale: The owner wants agents to have useful historical context in .intent even when reconstruction is imperfect. An explicit import transition records the reconstruction now without pretending the original commits captured intent or turning historical guesses into present-day constraints.
requirements: Import historical statements as intent revisions and exact historical blob bindings with evidence and pending verification
Validate metadata-only retrospective-import events and allow them alongside an exact unknown-provenance adoption baseline
Keep ordinary queries independent of the disposable analysis cache and retain coverage gaps
Recover interrupted publication from a journal, publish the manifest last, and never duplicate or rewrite immutable canonical records
title: Canonical historical imports preserve evidence and uncertain provenance
